author: Vampinity
note: waveydude's two settings WITHOUT a hog, 3 runs each, alternating (same shader stamp, so no warm-up beyond k0): control (play env v2.5-fast + census) / EDEN_HEAP_LARGE_MIB=8 / EDEN_HEAP_LARGE_KIB=256. Why: under the 896 MiB hog (t114-b) KIB=256 was the worst arm on speed (6.5 and 8.0 fps and one crash, against 10.4-15.6 for the control), and without a hog only MIB=8 has one run (16.9 against 18.6 fps). Before KIB=256 goes into owner's morning env it needs a plain read. Read: fly-over fps and 1% low, largest free block and heap MiB in the last 20 s lines, EDEN_HEAP_MID (taken, refused, cycles_m, large_entries of 4096, table_full). k0 is a WARM-UP (first boot on T116).
